description: This PHP file defines a class named 'ViewDisplayProperties' that extends 'ViewList' and is responsible for handling the display and processing of connector property views within the SuiteCRM system. It interacts with connector sources, retrieves configuration, filters modules based on access and source capabilities, and assigns variables to a template for rendering the connector display properties page.

classes.name: ViewDisplayProperties
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering the display properties interface for connectors in SuiteCRM, extending the ViewList class.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Configures display options such as showing all, Javascript, footer, and header settings, then calls the parent process method.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares data related to connector sources and modules, filters modules based on access and source limitations, assigns variables to the template engine, and renders the display properties template.
